org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business

Class FrameDisplayMgmt

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business.FrameDisplayMgmt
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class FrameDisplayMgmt
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Singleton EJB that manages real-time frame display and marking. Maintains the list of marked subimages and state machines for pending displays and marking actions. This EJB works in concert with AsyncController that is part of the polling mechanism to handle asynchronous event rendering.
    Author:
    smichaels
    See Also:
    AsyncController, Serialized Form
